metadata.question: Was there more rainfall near Villarrica during January 1 and December 31, 2021 as compared to 5 years prior?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data ("UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY") - Location: Villarrica, Paraguay (approx -25.75, -56.45) - Time periods: * 2021: Jan 1 - Dec 31 * 2016: Jan 1 - Dec 31 (5 years prior to 2021) - Band: 'precipitation' 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS precipitation data 3. Logic: - Get total annual precipitation for both years - Compare 2021 vs 2016 - Check for valid data and pixel counts - Output A if 2021 > 2016, B if not Need to handle: - Empty collections (C1) - No valid pixels (C2) - unlikely with CHIRPS but possible if region is invalid - Calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point([-56.45, -25.75]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Villarrica // Define time periods const period2021 = ['2021-01-01', '2021-12-31']; const period2016 = ['2016-01-01', '2016-12-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition const chirps2021 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(period2021[0], period2021[1]) .filterBounds(villarrica); const chirps2016 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(period2016[0], period2016[1]) .filterBounds(villarrica); // Check collection sizes const size2021 = chirps2021.size().getInfo(); const size2016 = chirps2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); console.log(`2016 Images: ${size2016}`); if (size2021 === 0 || size2016 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate annual precipitation totals const total2021 = chirps2021.sum().select('precipitation'); const total2016 = chirps2016.sum().select('precipitation'); // Check valid pixel counts const count2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const count2016 = total2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Valid Pixels: ${count2021}`); console.log(`2016 Valid Pixels: ${count2016}`); if (count2021 === 0 || count2016 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation values const mean2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const mean2016 = total2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2021 Mean Rainfall: ${mean2021 ? mean2021.toFixed(1) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`2016 Mean Rainfall: ${mean2016 ? mean2016.toFixed(1) : 'null'} mm`); if (mean2021 === null || mean2016 === null || isNaN(mean2021) || isNaN(mean2016) || mean2021 < 0 || mean2016 < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2021 > mean2016) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
